purpose.zh: 练腿后侧和下背，学会髋铰链
purpose.en: Build the hamstrings and lower back and learn the hip hinge.

text.zh: 臀部向后推，上身像平板一样前倾
text.en: Push your hips back and tip your trunk forward like a flat board

text.zh: 双手交叉放在胸前，膝盖微屈
text.en: Cross your hands on your chest and keep your knees soft.

text.zh: 腿后侧有拉伸感就停，再推髋站直
text.en: Stop when your hamstrings stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
